entry.title: New: Bill 132 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS THE PARKS AND RECREATIONAL FACILITY SCHEDULE, CHAPTER 15, ARTICLE 8, SECTION 15-68.1 OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), BY RENAMING KAHAKAI PARK, THE “WAIAKAHIʻULA BEACH PARK” IN RECOGNITION OF ITS ORIGINAL PLACE NAME

Latest action: Council: Bill 132 passes second & final reading - 03/20/24
